lede: The biggest thing to watch this week is Telluride Town Council's Tuesday meeting, where the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code comes up for its third and final reading — passage would amend the Land Use Code's historic review standards and landscaping rules to meet state wildfire mitigation requirements, which touches nearly every property owner in town. On Thursday, the County Planning Commission has real work on the table too: a subdivision mechanics work session and a referral on an energy code update that would reshape building standards for new construction. Woven around all that, the Jazz Festival rolls through the Sheridan and the Alibi, and the week wraps with the Ridgway Rendezvous carrying live music through the weekend.

notable.stake: Third-reading vote on wildfire code that rewrites land-use and landscaping rules.
County weighs subdivision rules and an energy code that sets new construction standards.
